exposure: mode of delivery: Cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery
cohort: Children born in Taiwan between 2004 and 2016
finding: Children delivered by Cesarean section had significantly higher risks of ADHD, ASD, and intellectual disability compared to those delivered vaginally, even after adjusting for maternal and child factors.
mod_finding: Children delivered by Cesarean section had significantly higher risks of ADHD, ASD, and intellectual disability compared to those delivered vaginally.
